subject: Supervised Framesmith run using upstream init contract
body: Run the corrected Framesmith real-work trial. The supervisor verified upstream src/bind.ts: init ensures requested projects and returns live re-keyed project IDs; consume that return directly. Runtime tools/list schemas are evidence and must be persisted. Do not invent project lookup semantics. Produce first render, same-canvas edit, second render, evaluation. On deterministic failure do not classify Framesmith failed from an adapter/control error; preserve exact evidence for immediate supervised correction/fallback.
